#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int search(int v, int k, int s, int last, vector<int>& counts, vector<vector<int>>& positions, vector<int>& totalCounts, vector<vector<vector<vector<int>>>>& dp) {
    int cv = counts[0], ck = counts[1], cs = counts[2];
    if (v == cv && k == ck && s == cs) return 0;
    if (dp[v][k][s][last] != -1) return dp[v][k][s][last];
    int res = INT_MAX / 2;
    if (v < cv) {
        int p = positions[0][v];
        int moveCost = max(totalCounts[p][0] - v, 0) + max(totalCounts[p][1] - k, 0) + max(totalCounts[p][2] - s, 0) - 1;
        res = min(res, search(v + 1, k, s, 0, counts, positions, totalCounts, dp) + moveCost);
    }
    if (k < ck && last != 0) {
        int p = positions[1][k];
        int moveCost = max(totalCounts[p][0] - v, 0) + max(totalCounts[p][1] - k, 0) + max(totalCounts[p][2] - s, 0) - 1;
        res = min(res, search(v, k + 1, s, 1, counts, positions, totalCounts, dp) + moveCost);
    }
    if (s < cs) {
        int p = positions[2][s];
        int moveCost = max(totalCounts[p][0] - v, 0) + max(totalCounts[p][1] - k, 0) + max(totalCounts[p][2] - s, 0) - 1;
        res = min(res, search(v, k, s + 1, 2, counts, positions, totalCounts, dp) + moveCost);
    }
    return dp[v][k][s][last] = res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<char> c(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> c[i];
    }

    vector<int> totalCounts(3, 0);
    vector<vector<int>> positions(3);
    vector<int> currentFreq(3, 0);
    vector<int> counts(3, 0);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char ch = c[i];
        switch (ch) {
            case 'V':
                currentFreq[0]++;
                counts[0]++;
                positions[0].push_back(i);
                break;
            case 'K':
                currentFreq[1]++;
                counts[1]++;
                positions[1].push_back(i);
                break;
            default:
                currentFreq[2]++;
                counts[2]++;
                positions[2].push_back(i);
                break;
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
            totalCounts[j] = currentFreq[j];
        }
    }

    int cv = counts[0], ck = counts[1], cs = counts[2];
    vector<vector<vector<vector<int>>>> dp(cv + 1, vector<vector<vector<int>>>(ck + 1, vector<vector<int>>(cs + 1, vector<int>(3, -1))));
    cout << search(0, 0, 0, 2, counts, positions, totalCounts, dp) << "\n";

    return 0;
}
